positioning_statement: Quillfern is the calm plant-care companion that gets beginners past the first struggling month, without promising that any plant cannot die.
target_audience: Renters aged roughly 25-39 who have already lost at least one houseplant, like plant content, and hesitate to spend money on plants again.

Closes the trust gap (gap 2) with real subscriber journeys connected to the offer.
